items.title: 19.6 Determination of the Molecular Formula (molecular formula maloom karna) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 19.6, PDF pages 46-47.

blocks.text: Aaiye in compounds ke molecular aur empirical formulae likhein (dono skeletal formulae neeche wali figure mein (a) aur (b) hain).

blocks.alt: Do saade skeletal formulae. a) Chaar carbon ka zigzag jis mein doosre aur teesre carbon ke darmiyan double bond hai (but-2-ene). b) Aik carbon jis se double bond oopar O tak, aik single lakeer neeche baen (CH3 wala carbon) aur aik single lakeer neeche daen NH2 tak jati hai (ethanamide).
blocks.caption: Compounds (a) aur (b) ke skeletal formulae (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Molecular formula maloom karne ke steps (qadam):

items: Skeleton mein dikhaye gaye C atoms aur heteroatoms (C aur H ke ilawa atoms, maslan O, N) ginein.
Har lakeer aik bond hai aur har joint (kona) aik carbon atom hai. (Dohri lakeer double bond hai.) Har lakeer ke sire par aik C atom ginein, jab tak wahan koi aur atom na likha ho.
Har C atom ka octet (chaar bond) poora karne ke liye jitne H atoms chahiyein, utne ginein:

blocks.alt: Dabbe mein solved (hal shuda) misal. (a) Chaar carbon ka zigzag jis mein doosre aur teesre carbon ke darmiyan double bond hai: teer dono sire wale carbon ko 'C atom + 3 H atoms' aur beech wale dono ko 'C atom + 1 H atom' batate hain. (b) Carbon skeleton jis mein C=O oopar aur NH2 neeche daen hai: aik teer baen sire ko 'C atom + 3 H atoms' aur doosra carbonyl carbon ko 'C atom (no H atoms)' batata hai.
blocks.caption: Skeletal formula se molecular formula maloom karna (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text:
Solution (hal):
a) Carbon atoms: 4. H atoms: 3 + 1 + 1 + 3 = 8.
Molecular formula = C₄H₈
Empirical formula: 4 : 8 = 1 : 2, yani CH₂
b) Carbon atoms: 2. H atoms: 3 (CH₃) + 2 (NH₂) = 5. N: 1, O: 1.
Molecular formula = C₂H₅NO
Empirical formula: 2 : 5 : 1 : 1 aur chhota nahi hota, is liye empirical formula bhi C₂H₅NO

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ethanamide ka empirical formula “CH₃CONH₂” likhti hai. Yeh us ka condensed structural formula hai. C₂H₅NO ke ratio 2 : 5 : 1 : 1 ko aur chhota nahi kiya ja sakta, is liye empirical formula bhi C₂H₅NO hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Bond-line structure Br–CH₂–CH₂–COOH ka molecular formula likhein.

blocks.explanation: Aik carbon jis se do chhoti lakeerein (do CH₃) niklein; yeh carbon dohri lakeer se agle carbon se jura ho, aur us carbon se aik single lakeer NH₂ tak jaye.

blocks.prompt: c) Woh ring jis ke aik hi carbon par CH₃ aur CH=CH–CH₃ lage hon, us ka molecular formula likhein.
blocks.explanation: Ring ke 6 C (5 CH₂ = 10 H), CH₃ ke 3 H aur CH=CH–CH₃ ke 3 C aur 5 H: total C₁₀H₁₈.

blocks.prompt: d) Molecular formulae batayein: i) do Cl wala cyclohexane ring ii) CH₂Cl aur CO₂H wala benzene ring.

items: Skeletal formula mein har kona aur lakeer ka sira aik carbon hai; har carbon ke chaar bond H se poore karein.
Ethanamide: molecular aur empirical dono C₂H₅NO.
